notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Fixed a crash resulting from the Warrior's Blood Rage skill due to the Overhealed Armor perk. The perk has been changed to now grant a 3% increase to the intensity of armor buffs when healing over maximum health.

Thank you to everyone who reported the issue, please let me know if you encounter any others!
